title: Count Unhappy Friends
sourceKind: official-page-blocked; statement and examples from WebSearch result summaries citing leetcode.com/problems/count-unhappy-friends, leetcode.doocs.org/en/lc/1583/, walkccc.me/LeetCode/problems/1583/
summary: n friends (n even) each rank the other n-1 friends; friends are split into n/2 pairs. Friend x is unhappy if x prefers some u over partner y, and u prefers x over u's partner v. Return the number of unhappy friends.
officialConstraints: 2 <= n <= 500; n is even; each preference list has length n-1, has unique entries, and never contains the friend's own index; each person is in exactly one pair.
visualizationNotes: Visualization caps n at 40 (IndexedSequence over friends). Full LeetCode range is up to 500.
